name: Class-Level Diagram
description: C4 code level diagram showing class structures and relationships
helpContent: Generate C4 code-level diagrams showing class hierarchies, interfaces, and dependencies at the code level.
template:
Create a C4 code level diagram showing:
1. Classes and interfaces
2. Inheritance and implementation relationships
3. Method signatures
4. Dependencies and associations
5. External library usage

Show the logical structure of the codebase.

name: Method-Level Interactions
description: C4 diagram showing method calls and interactions
helpContent: Design code-level diagrams showing how methods interact and call each other within the codebase.
template:
Generate a C4 code diagram showing:
1. Key classes and their methods
2. Method call sequences
3. Data transformations
4. Error handling paths
5. Integration with external services

Focus on critical code flows.
